LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_ArmorRecon.label: kwazaari light armor
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_ArmorRecon.descriptio:
Partially-powered armor, designed for mobility and ease-of-use. Meshes of Kwazaari Weave block attacks without adding excessive weight, and a complex endomuscular system in the lower body allows for uncompromised movement.
Armor such as this is often employed by kwazaari scout troops and higher-end police forces.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_ArmorHelmetRecon.desc: A high-tech kwazaari helmet with integrated optics and hardened weave plating. Built for scouting and rapid deployments where visibility and survivability both matter.
